scope: Exploratory training/development-only follow-up; never an added candidate in the frozen primary v12 comparison.
objective: Existing RLOO+CE and retention anchoring, plus BCE for the four named condition probabilities from the shared 64-dimensional readout projection. Auxiliary decoder is discarded before deployment.
targets: Parse only training/development requests to calculate the stated numeric conditions and conditional independent-sensor posteriors. Auxiliary labels are never supplied as inference inputs. No calibration or final groups enter the experiment.
selection: Same development eligibility and ranking. Compare median over three seeds against completed matched RLOO control; representative seed 131. Auxiliary prediction metrics are diagnostic and do not select candidates.
publication: No release approval follows from this pilot. A different selected model requires a separately declared complete evaluation cycle with the unchanged release thresholds.
